lines: Heeeey! No brawling in the hallway! It's after final dismissal!!
I didn't know how long she had been standing there, but we ended our scuffle and cowered in fear upon hearing Sakura-sensei's loud rebuke.
Hmph. We'll look the other way out of respect for Sakura-sensei!
But since you went there, how about you try to get at least one chocolate from someone with genuine feelings, young master!
Y-Yeah, actually, somebody already promised to give me some.
Since you brought it up, how about you bring it with you tomorrow then? I bet you won't be able to get any! Gyahahaha!!
Wah! Sorry! No ifs, ands, or buts, Fuma!!!
Damn it... let's go home too, Shikanosuke.
But Fuma, do you really have someone who's gonna give you some chocolate?
What are you gonna do, now that you've declared that? Hebiko isn't here because she's on a mission, so she won't even give you any out of obligation.
If possible I'd like to avoid that octopus ink chocolate anyways...
However, now I couldn't back out of it anymore. I headed home while racking my brain for a solution.
